category_title: Socially active preschoolers who use unfriendly tones and comments with peers
minimal_context: Nia is organizing a drawing activity with her friends during a 10-minute free play period in the preschool classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for our 10-minute free play period. You can go over to the art table and play with your friends.

STUDENT: I'm going to organize the drawing game! Everyone sit down and listen to me.

TUTOR: Go ahead and start your activity.

STUDENT: No, you aren't playing right. Your picture is messy.

TUTOR: Just keep playing together.

STUDENT: Stop! Get out of my way. I can do better than you, let me do that!

options.A: Providing follow-in talk that is related to the children's ongoing actions and attention during play.
options.B: Prompting, modeling, role-playing, and explicitly teaching desired social-emotional behaviors during the free play period.
options.C: Keeping the free play structure the same, starting with a visual attendance chart and group activities.
options.D: Asking the student what they think went wrong during free play instead of telling them.
